author: sweeeper
body:
Hi! This is my first map release, hope you'll like it!

Proelium (Fight in latin)
Updated! :D



Red vs blue, approximately room for about 40 players in each team, Three monuments (Right, Left and back)
Contains diamonds, iron, and gold. There's also one notch apple in the middle, but it's very risky to get to it.

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/Nta0s

(.RAR) Download ,contains the map.yml : http://www.mediafire.com/download/6j23dgn2iizrgpz/AVICUS_NEBULA_-_Proelium.rar

(.ZIP) Download http://www.mediafire.com/download/ctyd4ht9qmt13cs/avicus_nebula_-_proelium.zip

I now have the map.yml thanks to resepignev. Thank you!
